dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 05, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
METS STUN BRAVES IN THRILLING 10-9 WIN

The New York Mets outlasted the Atlanta Braves 10-9 in an instant classic, thanks in part to Drake Baldwin's explosive performance. Baldwin went 2-for-4 with a home run and 4 RBIs, propelling the Mets to their first win of the series. On the mound, Nolan McLean pitched 6 strong innings, allowing just 2 earned runs and striking out 5 Braves. Michael Harris II's late-inning single proved to be a highlight for the Braves, but ultimately came up short. 

Meanwhile, in other games, the Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Washington Nationals 11-5 behind Brandon Lowe's 3 RBIs, and the Minnesota Twins shut down the New York Yankees 6-1 behind Joe Ryan's 9 strikeouts.

Pirates Blast Nationals in 11-5 Rout

The Pittsburgh Pirates continued their hot start to the season, taking down the Washington Nationals 11-5. Brandon Lowe led the charge with a home run and 3 RBIs, while Konnor Griffin and Bryan Reynolds also contributed with key hits. On the mound, Gregory Soto pitched 5 strong innings, allowing just 1 earned run.

Twins Shut Down Yankees in 6-1 Win

The Minnesota Twins took care of business against the New York Yankees, winning 6-1 behind Joe Ryan's dominant performance. Ryan pitched 7 strong innings, striking out 9 Yankees and allowing just 1 earned run. Austin Martin and Royce Lewis also contributed with key hits, helping the Twins secure the win.
